subject.why: It is clearly a shiny red apple complete with stem, leaf, and the requested magical sparkle above the stem.

category.why: The apple rests on a flat, solid-colour surface viewed from slightly above, set against a smooth gradient wall in the same colour family without stripes or wood grain.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The apple is centrally placed with generous, balanced margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: Vibrant, saturated colours with strong complementary contrast between the red apple and the bright green background.

detail.why: The surface is clean and smooth with no micro-textures, scratches, or extra clutter.

style.why: Features chunky, rounded 3D forms with a smooth satin sheen, soft highlights, and no harsh outlines, matching the reference style.
